review_scope: All 30 independently presented host environments. Only the assigned review packet and tool contract were consulted for case material; no authored answers, templates, metadata, traces, or other reviews were read. No case tools were executed.
interpretation_notes: Decisions use each fixed as_of and the supplied synthetic procedures. Embedded CMS statements are treated as supplied episode facts; this review makes no independent real-world CMS interpretation.

must_observe_refs means the relevant record content must reach the model before its decision. Initial artifacts already satisfy observation; no redundant read_artifact call is required. Reveals require their own successful read and a subsequent model turn.

Evidence sets identify the current blocker; necessary observation sets can additionally include the governing procedure and inventories. Superseded records, archived incidents, and unrelated scheduling preferences are not mandatory observations.
The reason-code vocabulary overlaps. Accepted alternatives are valid only when accompanied by the same concrete blocker and actionable handoff; a matching code alone is insufficient.
A supported transmission returns a receipt_id, then complete must use that exact returned receipt_id. This completes transmission administration, not payer approval.
